invariants.text: No production implementation starts until an independent decision explicitly issues WP7_DESIGN_GATE_CONFIRMED.
The first implementation commit must descend from the accepted WP7 Activation identity binding commit 4ac6d2185bed28823210849704f3850cd875b5fb.
Design Gate candidate generation creates no Git commit and changes no tracked source tree.
Required-test names, matrices and evidence obligations defined here are requirements, not PASS claims.
Any implementation discovery requiring database schema, runtime authority or API contract semantic changes stops for a Design Amendment.
Convergence Pre-Review remains lightweight and cannot contain a final installer or Final Delivery identity.
Final Packaging cannot begin before WP7_PREACCEPTED_FOR_FINAL_PACKAGING.
Computer cleanup and final Windows installation occur only in the authorized final validation workflow, not during Design Gate or initial implementation.
This Readiness result does not activate WP7; WP7 remains inactive until a separate exact-parent activation workflow.
WP6 Activation identity remains historical and is never substituted for the WP6 accepted implementation or Final Delivery identity.
Package-local historical status never overrides a later formal audit decision.
Final Packaging is forbidden before WP7_PREACCEPTED_FOR_FINAL_PACKAGING.
The final installer is built from exactly one preaccepted frozen commit and tree.
Any production/build-tool/schema/test change after preacceptance invalidates preacceptance.
Real build starts from an empty unique staging root and never reuses an unsealed session.
WP1 PIPELINE_TEST_ONLY artifacts and protected hashes cannot enter final staging or evidence.
Electron, backend, installer and diagnostics consume the same verified release manifest and buildId.
Manifest protocol versions truthfully equal accepted runtime protocol constants.
sourceCommit equals gitCommit and frozenSourceCommit; sourceTree equals frozenSourceTree.
Payload and installer hashes are recomputed in the final build session and cannot be copied from development evidence.
Payload path canonicalization rejects traversal, absolute paths, symlinks, NFC collisions and Windows case collisions.
release manifest, detached hash, release evidence and installer are outside application payload aggregation.
Installed credential hydration, custody, idempotency, containment and projection agreement preserve accepted WP4 invariants.
Installed runtime uses Yance29 SQLite runtime_state as the sole operating-mode authority.
Yance27 is read-only and no safe-mode fallback source can affect the accepted runtime.
Installed Electron is DesktopHost only and backend is the sole business runtime.
API v2 event gaps force snapshot refetch and old runtime source/install residue is zero.
Every final evidence file joins on one frozen source, buildSessionId, buildId and installerSha256.
Phase1 aggregate references only final evidence under evidence/wp7 and never substitutes development evidence.
No screenshot or narrative claim substitutes for required machine-readable JSON evidence.
LOCAL_PRIVATE_UNSIGNED is truthful; missing Authenticode is not a Phase 1 failure.
Automatic update, upgrade-package and public-release acceptance cannot be claimed.
Inherited accepted risk records remain disclosed and are never silently closed.
Final Delivery contains the complete project source tree and complete source identity; incremental-only source is invalid.
The supplementary patch never substitutes for the complete source ZIP or complete Git bundle.
FINAL_INSTALLATION_MODE is CLEAN_INSTALL.
Legacy test data migration is neither required nor attempted.
Rollback or downgrade to a legacy test version is neither required nor attempted.
No old installed runtime, old process, old installer, old configuration, test database, cache, staging output or shortcut may influence final validation.
Installer SHA256 is verified immediately before installation and bound to every final evidence record.
First start initializes fresh state and must not silently consume a legacy test data root.
WP6 accepted runtime protocol version 3 is release truth; version 2 in historical reference material cannot enter the final manifest.
WP6 accepted unknown Windows limitations are converted into required WP7 final-machine evidence, not reported as already proven.

acceptanceCheckMapping.formalRequirement: After CLEAN_INSTALL, the final installed application starts, stops cleanly and starts again from the same sealed installer without legacy migration or rollback.
acceptanceCheckMapping.passOracle: Install status PASS; first start reaches local_ready; controlled stop confirms owner exit; restart reaches local_ready; installerSha256 and buildId are identical across all records; migrationAttempted=false; rollbackAttempted=false.

acceptanceCheckMapping.formalRequirement: Electron, backend, installer and diagnostics expose one identical buildId and one identical release identity tuple.
acceptanceCheckMapping.passOracle: All four consumers report the same buildId, productVersion, stageVersion, sourceCommit, sourceTree and manifest SHA256, with zero mismatches.

acceptanceCheckMapping.formalRequirement: Exactly one backend AppRuntime owns the installed business runtime at every observed point.
acceptanceCheckMapping.passOracle: Observed active AppRuntime owner count never exceeds one; crash/restart sequence yields one trusted replacement owner and zero overlapping owners.

acceptanceCheckMapping.formalRequirement: Installed runtime never reads or obeys any legacy safe-mode fallback source after accepted authority exists.
acceptanceCheckMapping.passOracle: Legacy safe-mode file, environment, desktop settings, renderer storage and system-policy mutations produce zero authority changes; Yance29 SQLite remains sole authority.

acceptanceCheckMapping.formalRequirement: local_ready is impossible until credential hydration and all required authority projections agree.
acceptanceCheckMapping.passOracle: Every local_ready transition is preceded by successful credential hydration, trusted owner validation and projection agreement; injected early-ready mutation is rejected.

acceptanceCheckMapping.formalRequirement: The installed application reaches local_ready while offline and reports explicit, truthful capability state.
acceptanceCheckMapping.passOracle: With network unavailable, local_ready completes within the defined timeout; unavailable external capabilities are explicit; no false online capability is reported.

acceptanceCheckMapping.formalRequirement: The final installed tree contains zero old runtime code, duplicate runtime entrypoints or forbidden legacy residue.
acceptanceCheckMapping.passOracle: Canonical installed-tree inventory and process/residual scan report zero forbidden files, zero duplicate runtime entrypoints and zero legacy runtime processes.

acceptanceCheckMapping.formalRequirement: The final installer is produced from clean staging and never uses an old installer plus app.asar.unpacked overlay or post-install runtime patch.
acceptanceCheckMapping.passOracle: Staging starts empty; every payload byte has current-session provenance; overlay/post-install patch scanners report zero hits; sealed installer hash remains unchanged.

acceptanceCheckMapping.formalRequirement: Every startup failure exposes machine-readable buildId, failedPhase and stable reasonCode.
acceptanceCheckMapping.passOracle: Each injected startup failure produces valid JSON containing the exact buildId, non-empty failedPhase and allowlisted reasonCode; no narrative-only failure record is accepted.

acceptanceCheckMapping.formalRequirement: All stage-level release evidence is machine-readable JSON, schema-valid, SHA256-pinned and joined to one final identity tuple.
acceptanceCheckMapping.passOracle: A01-A10 each appear exactly once; every referenced child JSON parses and validates; every reference has SHA256; all records share source, buildSessionId, buildId and installerSha256; no development evidence is referenced.

phaseClasses.meaning: Must execute and PASS before WP7 Convergence Pre-Review submission; no final installer or real-machine claim is permitted.
Must execute and PASS before Convergence Pre-Review using implementation/tooling fixtures, then execute again against the frozen final build or final evidence during Final Packaging.
Runs only after WP7_PREACCEPTED_FOR_FINAL_PACKAGING against final packaging identities or complete delivery closure; not required to enter Convergence Pre-Review.
Runs only during authorized real Windows CLEAN_INSTALL validation against the sealed final installer; not required to enter Convergence Pre-Review.

requiredTestPhaseModel.repeatRule: Every PRE_REVIEW_AND_FINAL test must have a pre-review execution record and a separate final execution record. A pre-review PASS cannot substitute for final-machine or final-package execution.
